observations: 2 photos show a portable electronic keyboard still wrapped in plastic/packaging.
Keyboard has a full set of black/white keys; control panel with buttons/knobs is visible but not clearly readable.
No clear brand/model name is readable on the photos.
No adapter/power cable is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Quality London used keyboard with super sounds
claims.evidence: Photos only show the keyboard wrapped; no audio/demo or readable branding/model.
No power-on test or close-up of functioning controls; keyboard is wrapped.
No adapter/cable is visible in either photo.
No receipt, label, or documentation shown.
No audio playback or key-by-key test shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model is not readable, so the exact feature set (e.g., number of keys, pitch bend, speakers, sound engine) and typical value are uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front panel/model label (or the back label) showing brand + exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used portable keyboard with unknown model/features.

risks.risk: Functionality risk: keys/buttons may have faults (dead keys, stuck buttons) and audio may crackle.
risks.proof: Video of power-on plus a quick key sweep (all keys) and a short audio demo showing no crackle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Missing accessories: adapter may not be included or may be the wrong voltage/connector.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/cable included next to the keyboard (showing label/voltage).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage risk hidden under plastic (cracked casing, loose knobs, damaged speaker).
risks.proof: Unwrapped close-ups of the corners, speaker area, and control panel; plus a back-side photo.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand + exact model number/label (front or back).
Video: power-on, then press every key (or a full-range sweep) and show all buttons/knobs responding.
Short audio recording/demo (showing no crackle) at normal volume.
Photo of the adapter/cable included with its label/voltage.
response.reason: The photos don’t show the brand/model or any power-on/accessory evidence, so a worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct keyboard type and condition.
